text:
mina.ramirez: Announcing new Audit Export feature for Private/VPC GA customers + a customer-readiness checklist. This allows customers to request signed, timebound audit bundles (logs, config snapshots) for compliance reviews.

harold.eng: Platform change? what's the retention and signing mechanism?

mina.ramirez: Platform-layer exporter: on-request bundle signed with customer KMS proof (attestation), retention configurable per SOW. Default retention 90 days unless customer opts otherwise.

ops-bot: Feature flag created: PLAT-2711-audit-export (owner: eng-platform). Dry-run enabled for first 5 installs.

linda.legal: Added SOW clause draft SOW-AUD-1: describes export scope, SLAs for turnaround (48h), and customer acceptance of export integrity proof. Also includes handling of subpoena/third-party requests.

eve.cs: CS ask: need a one-paragraph customer script and an FAQ explaining how long exports take, expected size, and impact on runtime.

mina.ramirez: We'll add FAQ. Quick notes: export is asynchronous, non-blocking, expected size depends on retention window; compressed bundles and optional delta export available.

harold.eng: Security note: we'll only sign bundles using customer KMS KEK via Envelope encryption. Sample policy snippet: 
```
Action: kms:Encrypt
Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd
Condition: StringEquals: kms:EncryptionContext: {"redwood:export": "audit-bundle"}
```

linda.legal: Also require customer opt-in for telemetry within exports. If telemetry is off, bundles exclude performance traces. Need explicit checkbox in SOW.

exec-briefing-bot: Exec note: this feature responds to SOC/ISO audit asks; will prepare short exec summary for customers with upcoming audits.

eve.cs: Ops checklist for PS runbook:
- Validate KMS attestation with customer key
- Ensure NTP drift < 500ms
- Confirm disk encryption and disabled encrypted-swap
- Run dry export and verify signature
- Communicate expected downtime windows (none for export)

mina.ramirez: Also adding a migration note: existing Private installs can enable audit-export via feature flag; PS to run verification. We'll not auto-enable.

harold.eng: Platform ticket PLAT-2711 tracks export worker, signer integration, and size estimates. ETA 2 sprints.

linda.legal: Legal will add sample acceptance language and subpoena handling.

eve.cs: I'll prep AE one-pager and email template. ETA EOD Thursday.

mina.ramirez: Merging docs to KB at /kb/onprem-audit-export-v1.0. Please review before dry-run start at 1823456900. Keep feedback focused and actionable. :memo:
